# Thumbnail shoot round 2, 2026-10-23 (Play, branch claude/project-thread-cv5vcp at 7a1f516)

Staging (server, ServerStorage.DebugSet): realm 10, lives 41 (red band), pass + ride swordJade. Avatar as round 1 (shots.md).
Rider: HumanoidRootPart anchored (server) at P = (-502.94, 115, 110.78). Light: client DayNightOffset set into the day, ClockTime 16.5 every frame.
UI: every PlayerGui LayerCollector off (re-hidden every frame), CoreGui off, DisplayDistanceType None.
Camera rig: shotrig2.luau (round 1 rig + day keep-alive + per-frame UI hide). Captures: MCP screen_capture, 1920x821.

Geometry (rider space): glyph rings 10 studs wide at y-2.8, bead ring around the head (y+1.6..+4.6) just behind it, blade along the rider's facing at y-1.9 (tip forward, hilt behind).

Findings:
- The glyph rings only draw from above. From below (F1, F1v and the low E2 tries) they vanish and the aura becomes a white glow.
- Tip-forward (E2) hides the blade behind the legs by construction; the whole blade only reads when it's 40 to 90 deg off the camera axis.
- Looking near the sun (az within ~25 deg) blows the rider out. G2 is lit from the side (sun right of frame), not truly from behind.
- az -60 to -100 at high pitch brings floating islands into the bottom right (D2 tries); az -30 is clean.
